infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Atlas uses the microphone only while you are speaking to the assistant.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Atlas converts your speech into text so your private assistant can respond.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Atlas uses Face ID to confirm sensitive actions before carrying them out.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Atlas to listen while you speak.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Allow Atlas to convert your voice to text.
